title: Golden hour
notes: A rising crane with a slow push from low above the snow west of the Swanky Summit Lodge (it faces west: deck and glass dining room toward the camera) to about 15 to 18 m above the slope, looking east at the lodge, the Bowl Gondola base, the Summit Express base and the lit peak. A snow mound hides the lift bases in the first second (the reveal). Ground: 1078.1 at x 3030, 1083.5 at x 3045. State: the clock moved one game day plus to 20:41 sim time (lamps on), temperature -8, cloudiness 0. Note: one game day moves the normalized date by about 0.09 here (it read 0.655, not a July 0.52); a climate date override did not change the light. Time of Day 19.6 was the warmest light that still lights the buildings (19.2 and 19.45 leave the lodge in shade); take 2 used 19.45. Path 9 s plus a 1.5 s hold for the end card. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60).
